title: Canyon Enterprise licence
description: The licence that unlocks Canyon Enterprise's features (#2879; contracts/routes.md, Licence). The root is the licence file, as CANYON_LICENSE holds it (its content, or the path of a file holding it) and as an admin pastes it: payload is the standard base64 of the payload's JSON bytes and signature the standard base64 of Canyon's 64-byte Ed25519 signature over those exact bytes, so no re-encoding can change what was signed. It is verified offline against the public keys compiled into the server. A missing, lapsed or unreadable licence never weakens the review and never stops what runs: it locks adding or changing an Enterprise feature, nothing else.

payload.description: What Canyon signed: who it is for, when it was issued and until when it holds, how many seats, and which features it unlocks. A feature name this server does not know unlocks nothing here and is still shown.

feature.description: The Enterprise features this server gates, in its order: credentials Canyon adds to apps' calls (credential routes), platform patching (patching and rebuilds), and access by sign-in group (groups_claim and group grants).

state.description: GET /api/v1/licence. state: none (no licence), valid (before expires), grace (expires passed less than 30 days ago), lapsed (30 days or more ago), invalid (a licence is set, but it is not a licence file or no key this server holds verifies it). allows: the features this Canyon unlocks now, the known features the licence names while valid or grace, [] otherwise. A member is answered those two alone; an admin also where the licence came from and, for one that verifies, what it says, for an invalid one why.

source.description: env: CANYON_LICENSE sets it, and no route changes it; dashboard: an admin pasted it.

grace_until.description: expires plus 30 days: when grace ends and the licence lapses.

features.description: Every feature the licence names, known here or not, in its order.

problem.description: Why a licence is invalid: unreadable (not a licence file, or CANYON_LICENSE names a file the server can't read), unsigned (no key this server holds verifies it).

allOf.description: Only a licence in force unlocks anything.
An admin's read of a licence that verifies says all of it.
An admin's read of an invalid licence says why, and nothing a licence would say.
A read with no source, a member's or no licence's, says nothing of a licence.

set.description: PUT /api/v1/licence: the licence file's text, exactly as issued.

refused.description: 409 licence_required: adding or changing an Enterprise feature while no valid or grace licence names it. feature names which; message says it needs Canyon Enterprise, that what is set keeps working, and where an admin adds a licence.
